thisWeeksMove.label: GA4 momentum keeps building; a 13-month-old automation decision finally closed
thisWeeksMove.body: The GA4 sessions turnaround that started last week (+1.22%) has strengthened to +10.7% vs the prior 30 days, and genuine leads (form submissions + tap-to-calls) climbed to 261 from 231. The long-open Google Business Automation scoping question (open since GBP work was first delegated) was resolved today: closed as superseded rather than built, since SEO's move to a service-page structure means the blog-to-GBP auto-repost it assumed no longer fits the current content cadence. The September blog stays fully drafted and ready, now 4 days past due at the Duda-publish wall; the podcast-findability page and the team-photo shot list both went from untouched to fully prepped today.
thisWeeksMove.cta: Send Kevin the real daily budget number for the RP Funding campaign (or confirm pivoting to the October show); publish the September blog in Duda

lumenDid: Reviewed your FieldRoutes lead sources for the last 30 days: Google search is driving your bookable leads, while Facebook shows next to none we can directly attribute (a portion come in as N/A or phone call-ins). That is exactly why we are doubling down on Google Ads and the website — Facebook earns its keep as top-of-funnel awareness, but search is what rings the phone

Rebuilt your Google Ads: lifted Ad Strength from Poor to Good, split Search into focused General Pest Control + Termite ad groups, and trimmed targeting to your 4 core counties (Polk, Orange, Brevard, Hillsborough) so you stop paying for Tampa/Orlando clicks
Turned off the Meta 'Audience Network' placements that were driving low-quality clicks, so more of your ad spend reaches real Central Florida prospects
Cleaned up your conversion tracking — GA4 now counts real phone calls and form submissions, not inflated page views
Locked three Pest Detectives podcast shoot dates with Kevin & Sean (Aug 26, Sep 23, Oct 21) and scheduled an August newsletter resend to 6,182 subscribers who hadn't opened yet

Sept 17-19: Shipped same-day-service ad copy to all 4 N. FL ad groups, fixed a stale-content gap on the 3 social captions, verified the AI SEO audit's NF page copy + H1 fixes are live, and pulled fresh Ads/Meta/GA4 data each day. Sessions decline eased for 5 straight days.

Sept 20: Built the RP Funding Center geofenced Meta campaign in full (1-mile radius around the expo venue, brand-matched creative, call button, Advantage+ off) and left it sitting paused in draft with zero spend, flagged with a placeholder budget in its own name so it can never be mistaken for live — only Kevin's real number is missing.

Sept 21: Fresh 7-day Ads/Meta and 30-day GA4 numbers pulled across all 6 hubs — GA4 sessions turned positive for the first time (+1.22%), genuine leads up to 231. Re-tested the Mailchimp connector (still blocked). Confirmed the RP Funding chase email and Meta campaign draft are both exactly where they should be, no duplicates, nothing sent.

Sept 22: Closed the 13+ month Google Business Automation scoping decision as superseded (not built — SEO's service-page direction made the blog→GBP repost obsolete). Wrote first concrete steps and drafted the actual copy for 2 previously-untouched deliverables: the podcast-findability page and the team-photo shot list. Refreshed backlink baseline (+189 links, +63 domains) and caught a real rank gain (termite treatment milton 8→5). Filed a new Rail-3 handoff for scheduling the drafted social captions in Meta Business Suite. GA4 momentum confirmed strengthening (+10.7% sessions, 261 leads).
